# Roofnest

> Roofnest designs and sells premium rooftop tents, awnings, and camping accessories for adventure vehicles including trucks, SUVs, and cars.

Roofnest specializes in innovative rooftop tent solutions featuring their flagship Condor and Falcon series, with vehicle-specific collections and a comprehensive ecosystem of mounting hardware, awnings, and camping gear. The company serves overlanding and car camping enthusiasts seeking durable, weather-resistant shelter solutions.

## Key Topics

- Rooftop tents
- Condor 2 series
- Falcon 3 series
- Awnings and annexes
- Rooftop tent accessories
- Mounting hardware
- Vehicle-specific collections
- Fold-out tents
- Clamshell tents
- FeatherBed Air mattress
- Overlanding gear
- Camping equipment
- Toyota 4Runner
- Jeep vehicles
- Subaru vehicles
